question: Into what range of parts should the base breadth be divided for measurement?
premises: Division begins from a sixth part.
Division extends up to a sixteenth part.
The base breadth is the object divided.
inference: The base breadth should be divided into parts ranging from one-sixth to one-sixteenth.
plain_english: Having divided the base breadth into parts ranging from a sixth up to a sixteenth, one should determine its measure.
